jobs_results.title: SAP Testing Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a SAP Testing Senior Project Manager to be part of our IT Platforms Department.

Position Snapshot
• Location: Nestlé Global Tech Hub in Barcelona, Spain
• Type of Contract: Permanent
• Stream: IT Platforms
• Type of work: Hybrid
• Work Language: Fluent Business English
• Grade: G1

The role

In this position, you will bring deep expertise and knowledge to the SAP Landscape platform group team. As an SAP Testing Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for guiding and promoting the proper testing framework & tools amongst the regional testing leads, coaching and supporting functional experts in the testing of the S/4HANA program and other technical projects.

You will work closely with the SAP Landscape team and suppliers to ensure that the manual regression testing milestones are achieved in time and with the quality standards agreed. Also, you will be responsible for supervising the testing framework and tools as well as the implementation within the scope... agreed, owning the overall testing strategy and governance.

What you’ll do

• Make recommendations on how to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and delivery of testing services through use of (emerging) technology and technical methods and methodologies.

• Drive S/4 HANA technical projects, leading the testing teams.

• Participate in the development of and/or review of S/4 HANA testing strategy, documentation, and methods.

• Liaise closely with vendors for proof of concepts of new tools available in the market related to manual and automated testing.

• Work with IS/IT Innovation managers, Platform managers, Product Stream Operations Managers and Business Analysts as required to ensure S/4 HANA testing can be covered.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
• Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.
• Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
• Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!
• Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience

• Strong stakeholder management

• 10+ years in IT field, focusing on S/4 HANA projects, including experience in SAP testing, and managing testing tools such as Solution Manager and Azure DevOps.

• Good understanding of test automation platforms.

• Strong background in SAP project management

• Thorough understanding of software development lifecycle, specifically automated quality assurance processes

Bonus points if you:

• Have excellent analytical and technical skills.

• Have experience with effective communication at different levels in the organization and in English.

• Have experience working in a global environment and with virtual teams.

About the IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé’s IT Hub #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed: You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are selecting a Project Manager for Cummins Spain, San Fernando de Henares. Hybrid work model, travelling 60%, relocation is not eligible. English high level (C1 Cambridge equivalent) is a MUST. In this role, you will make an impact in some of the following ways: - Identifying project stakeholders, risks, work scope, budget and schedule expectations - Developing Project Plans - Reporting to both internal and external stakeholders, including Company Leaders, the status of his/her projects: time schedule, costs vs. Budget, risks, technical issues, etc - Coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure that the project execution plan has correctly identified the required resources, tools, and methodology. - Understanding project activities and interdependencies in order to support the development of an accurate budget and schedule, then managing project execution accordingly. - Understanding contractual terms and conditions - Serving as the primary client interface - Supporting the... establishment of effective working relationships, both within the project team and between the project team and external stakeholders. Measuring project performance, forecasting outcomes and, when necessary, developing proactive course corrections - Ensuring that the project team is adhering to applicable Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Quality Management, and Projects Systems - From the sales process, identifying and register the Projects’ risks, monitoring these risks while using creativity and out-of-the-box thinking to propose mitigation
To be successful in this role you will need the following: - Engineering College, University, or equivalent degree required - Electrical or Mechanical background preferably - Relevant work experience in Engineering Project Management (2 to 4 years minimum) - Very high level of Spanish & English language: written and oral communications (minimum level C1 equivalent) - Main skills/competences: Excellent Communication skills, Team oriented, Solution driven. - Availability to travel (60%)
Compensation Class

CC02

jobs_results.title: Footprint Project Manager - Europe
jobs_results.description:
About Lubrizol

The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a specialty chemical company whose science delivers sustainable solutions to advance mobility, improve wellbeing and enhance modern life. Founded in 1928, Lubrizol owns and operates more than 100 manufacturing facilities, sales, and technical offices around the world and has about 8,000 employees. For more information, visit www.Lubrizol.com.

We value diversity in professional backgrounds and life experiences. By enabling a consistent, unbiased, and transparent recruitment process, Lubrizol seeks to create a positive experience for candidates so we can get to know them at their best. We recognise unique work and life situations and offer flexibility, ensuring our employees feel engaged and fulfilled in every aspect of life.

Join Our Thriving Team at Lubrizol as Footprint Project Manager!

Unleash Your Potential! At Lubrizol we're transforming the footprint optimization and looking for exceptional talent to... join us on this journey. If you are ready to join an international company with 8000 employees around the world and want to make a real impact, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do:

As a Footprint Project Manager, you'll be at the forefront of our footprint optimization, driving exciting projects and initiatives and will assist in developing a network map for manufacturing facilities and consolidation plans that align with the business. You will be responsible for coordinating multi-disciplinary teams to implement and complete large-scale projects that align with the business strategy and goals for Lubrizol with the objective of optimizing the footprint of Lubrizol in Europe.

What We're Looking For:

• Responsible for the coordination, implementation, control, and completion of projects, while remaining aligned with strategy, commitments, and goals of Lubrizol.

• Set deadlines, manage work stream owners within different departments, assign responsibilities, and monitor and summarize progress of project.

• Manage closing plants' projects and closing lab projects.

• Manage product transfer projects both in coordination with plant consolidations and as a separate project.

• Support the Footprint (Network) Director in creation of the network map (an overall classification of sites and plan for consolidation, closing or maintenance)

• With support from manufacturing technology which will select the most effective technologies, create the automation and advanced manufacturing plan which will outline where and when these technologies will be put in place in the remaining plants

• Provide risk/reward trade-off to business groups for decisions

• Communicate and escalate risks that could impact objectives and deliverables

Skills That Make a Difference:

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in engineering or program management

• Experience in plant closures and product transfers, particularly where customer or regulatory approvals are required

• Minimum 10 years of combined business and Operations/Manufacturing experience

• Proven track record of project management experience

• Expertise in using project management tools such as MS project

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong facilitation capability

• Exceptional critical thinking skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, outlook, teams, and SharePoint)

• Ability to be organized, problem solver solution oriented   

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is a plus

• Chemical experience is an advantage

• Willing to travel 20%-30% mainly in Europe          

Perks and Rewards That Inspire:

• Develop your professional career with a highly respected, industry-leading, multinational company that is part of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.

• Become part of a culture that is based on accountability and empowerment and which values diversity and inclusivity.

• A competitive remuneration and benefits package

#LI-MC1

#LI-MC1

#LI-Hybrid

Ready for your next career step? Apply today and let's shape the future together!

It’s an exciting time to be part of Lubrizol. Lubrizol is not staying put. We are continually learning and evolving. Our passion delivers our success — not only for Lubrizol but for those who count on us every day: our employees, customers, and communities.

As a diverse, global team, we work together to solve some of the world’s most pressing challenges. We impact everyday lives through science only Lubrizol can deliver, and we never stop pushing to do it better.

One of the founding principles of The Lubrizol Corporation more than 90 years ago was treating every employee with dignity and respect. That same commitment is only stronger today.

More than that, we are committed to providing an environment where every employee can be the best they can be, no matter their ethnic origin, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
The Company

Gray Matter isn't just in the software development business; we're in the art of constructing the future's leading SaaS companies. Our passion lies in harnessing AI to supercharge our products, adopting a product-led growth strategy that ensures scalability and impact.

As a Startup Studio, we're dedicated to the ideation, creation, and elevation of world-class SaaS solutions, aiming to empower individuals and organizations to achieve greatness through exceptional software.

The Situation

Gray Matter is on the lookout for a Project Manager who thrives on bringing ideas to life and ensuring projects are completed efficiently and effectively. We need someone who is passionate about managing the intricacies of software development projects, facilitating communication between diverse teams, and driving projects to successful completion. If you excel in a fast-paced environment and are looking for a role where your work directly influences the success of innovative products... we're eager to meet you.

The Role

As a Project Manager at Gray Matter, you will:
• Project Planning and Execution: Develop detailed project plans to monitor and track progress. Lead the execution of projects from conception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Team Leadership: Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects. Serve as the liaison between project teams and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative work environment.
• Risk Management: Identify potential risks and devise contingency plans to manage them effectively.
• Communication: Ensure that all projects are communicated in a timely and clear manner to all stakeholders. Conduct regular project status meetings and provide updates on project milestones and deliverables.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:
• +5 Years of Experience: Proven work experience in project management, specifically in the software development or tech industry.
• Strong Organizational Skills: Excellent attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
• Leadership: Exceptional leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and lead project teams to achieve productivity and meet project goals.
• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex information to all stakeholders clearly.
• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate challenges and adjust project plans as necessary to meet objectives.
• Project Management Qualifications: Certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is highly desirable.

What's in It for You
• Impactful Work: Play a pivotal role in the development and launch of cutting-edge SaaS products, directly contributing to the company's success.
• Growth Opportunity: Work in an environment that's fertile ground for professional growth, offering ample opportunities to hone your skills and advance your career.
• Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and diversity, where your ideas and contributions are valued and encouraged.
• Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a remote-first culture, with the opportunity to collaborate in person in beautiful Barcelona if you choose.

If you're passionate about project management and excited about the opportunity to lead projects that shape the future of technology, we'd love to have you join our team at Gray Matter. Apply today and help us build software solutions that stand out in the digital landscape

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time PROJECT MANAGER in Barcelona we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your PROJECT MANAGEMENT expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll drive project execution, to maximize the results with respect to cash and margin whilst delivering on time, in conformity with the contract Charter according to Customer expectations and the requirements on EHS. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Customer , Partners, Project Team, Line Managers providing... resources, Project Office, Support functions (Finance, Tax, Legal, etc..) and other project stakeholders.

You’ll specifically take care of seeking and proposing to the Customer Director additional opportunities in the frame of the contract Charter, but also ensuring Alstom Transport legal and contractual rights are protected.

We’ll look to you for:
• Plan and manage the complete execution of his/her scope from transfer to close out, in line with Contract Charter requirements.
• Lead a Project Team, including Core Team and when applicable Project Managers of internal and external partners - in line with the project structure.
• Perform project management and contract administration according to Alstom Project Management Manual (PMM), including proactive risk and opportunity management, and in full compliance with E&C rules.
• Ensure completion of Project Performance goals to meet business objectives and customer satisfaction.
• Responsible and accountable for the Project Profit and Loss
• Ensure optimal quality of project execution and reviews.
• Ensure that critical aspects are identified in reviews and proactively / professionally addressed and followed up.
• Manage the situation of the project and its KPIs, and report to senior management, with transparency during the business/sector project reviews or PRB
• Make sure that key project stakeholders are aligned towards project goals.
• Represent Alstom towards Customers and when applicable external stakeholders (Consortium, JV …)
• EHS: Accountable for the proper implementation of the Alstom policy and Customer requirements by all stakeholders
• (internal & external) including suppliers and contractors.
• Responsible to ensure full compliance with Code of Ethics

Performance measurements:
• Sales
• Physical progress
• Gate review Go on time / OTD- GR
• Cash-in
• Customer Satisfaction
• EHS when applicable

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering or Civil Engineering
• Language skills: High level in English is a must. French other language is an asset
• Previous experience of 5 years of relevant Project Management experience. Desirable career experience in Railways
• Good knowledge of Project management processes (background level depending on the complexity of the Project)
• Good knowledge of railway products and systems.
• Experience in managing wide range subcontractor companies along with several different typology of products
• Experience of working in and with multi-national companies and in different business cultures
• Recognized project management qualification
• Experience/knowledge of contract management with Spanish administration.
• Used to work on a goal-driven basis environment
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills,
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting,
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.
• Strong skills and resilience to manage uncertainty
• Located in Barcelona (Cataluña area and availability according to project needs)

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.

You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

You’ll specifically take care of seeking and proposing to the Customer Director additional opportunities in the frame of the contract Charter, but also ensuring Alstom Transport legal and contractual rights are protected.

We’ll look to you for:
• Plan and manage the complete execution of his/her scope from transfer to close out, in line with Contract Charter requirements.
• Lead a Project Team, including Core Team and when applicable Project Managers of internal and external partners - in line with the project structure.
• Perform project management and contract administration according to Alstom Project Management Manual (PMM), including proactive risk and opportunity management, and in full compliance with E&C rules.
• Ensure completion of Project Performance goals to meet business objectives and customer satisfaction.
• Responsible and accountable for the Project Profit and Loss
• Ensure optimal quality of project execution and reviews.
• Ensure that critical aspects are identified in reviews and proactively / professionally addressed and followed up.
• Manage the situation of the project and its KPIs, and report to senior management, with transparency during the business/sector project reviews or PRB
• Make sure that key project stakeholders are aligned towards project goals.
• Represent Alstom towards Customers and when applicable external stakeholders (Consortium, JV …)
• EHS: Accountable for the proper implementation of the Alstom policy and Customer requirements by all stakeholders
• (internal & external) including suppliers and contractors.
• Responsible to ensure full compliance with Code of Ethics

Performance measurements:
• Sales
• Physical progress
• Gate review Go on time / OTD- GR
• Cash-in
• Customer Satisfaction
• EHS when applicable

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering or Civil Engineering
• Language skills: High level in English is a must. French other language is an asset
• Previous experience of 5 years of relevant Project Management experience. Desirable career experience in Railways
• Good knowledge of Project management processes (background level depending on the complexity of the Project)
• Good knowledge of railway products and systems.
• Experience in managing wide range subcontractor companies along with several different typology of products
• Experience of working in and with multi-national companies and in different business cultures
• Recognized project management qualification
• Experience/knowledge of contract management with Spanish administration.
• Used to work on a goal-driven basis environment
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills,
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting,
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.
• Strong skills and resilience to manage uncertainty
• Located in Barcelona (Cataluña area and availability according to project needs)

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.

You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Responsible for:
Reviewing all project documentation from the Sales team that commissions projects. Manages the project kickoff meeting to review materials and project timelines, finalizing all project requirements. Analyzes daily fielding information from internal systems, internal recruitment and vendors, proactively providing feedback information and solutions to the client as appropriate.

Key Deliverables of the Role:
• Demonstrate ownership of the project from commissioning to closure and communicating directly with clients. Coordinate project schedule and working with internal departments.
• Make recommendations and suggest solutions to clients to meet the needs of the project life cycle, defining project goals at the onset of each project and ensuring that those goals are achieved or flagging areas of concern to managers to address and resolve along with proposed solutions for implementation.
• Implement plans for project progression and raise to manager if there are issues... that jeopardize the team’s ability to complete the project in a timely and cost effective manner. Communicate project changes and progress to internal departments timely and accurately.
• Efficiently utilize internal project management tools, sharing information with junior team members and helping advise them on system issues.

Essential Qualifications and Experience Required:
• 2-4 years of project management experience is desirable
• Healthcare background is a plus
• Experience with Market Research Projects would be a benefit
• Fluent in English, both written and oral
• Any other foreign language (s) would be an advantage
• Proficient usage of MS Office
• Ability to adopt and learn on company proprietary platforms
• Numerical skills

Role Specific Technical Skills or Knowledge Required:
• Effective professional communication skills and excellent interpersonal skills
• Excellent organizational, prioritization and planning skills with a solid attention to details
• Ability to work well independently as well as part of the team or mentor junior team members
• Analytical skills & logical thinking
• Ability to follow procedures, but also flexibility to propose solutions for ad-hoc cases
• Looking for ways to improve and promote quality
• Proactively addressing potential problems and taking responsibility if errors occur, working with managers to correct any issues
• Articulates ideas coherently and clearly both internally and externally

jobs_results.title: Team Lead (Digital Project Management)
jobs_results.description:
Location: Remote - Anywhere (Open to applicants located anywhere around the globe.)

Team Leads are a crucial part of our Client Delivery team. This role has responsibilities in both project and personnel management across a team of collaborative, cross-discipline professionals who have been pushing the boundaries of enterprise-level projects for over 12 years.

You’ll have ownership and input on a combination of innovative, challenging projects and ongoing support engagements—we believe in balanced and diverse workloads through dedicated resource management. We have a supportive Client Delivery structure, with established PM processes, while still allowing for autonomy.

As a leading digital agency, 10up’s client roster spans from innovative startups and impactful non-profits, to some of the biggest names in the industry, such as ESPN, Google, The New York Times Co., and The Nobel Prize Committee.

As a 10upper, you have options for flexible and alternative work schedules... Intentionally remote since day one, spanning six continents and 38+ countries, 10up fully embraces the benefits of distributed work.

What you will do:
• Manage a team of 5-8 cross-discipline direct reports, including oversight of their project resourcing, professional development and general well-being.
• Work closely with group leadership to proactively and professionally raise and mitigate concerns with team members and/or projects within your pod.
• Act as the day-to-day Project Manager for 2-5 active projects; exhibiting an expert level ownership over all project scopes/plans, client meetings, written status updates, demos, risk management and iterative scope / expectation management. Successfully create and execute project plans to deliver fixed price, retainer, and T&M projects within expected timelines and budgets.
• Ensure superior quality deliverables by collaboratively engaging cross-discipline leadership, and enforcing rigorous QA processes and standards to provide end to end delivery and client satisfaction.
• Lead discovery engagements (onsite and remotely) that expertly define cross-discipline project requirements and that demonstrate an expert understanding of underlying client business goals and objectives. Consistently identify strategic opportunities to engage with the 10up Account Management Team and collaborate towards building strong, long-term client relationships.

About you:
• You are the beating heart of your cross-discipline pod of teammates. You have experience managing direct reports, leading collaborative team meetings and ensuring a healthy and engaged culture amongst your team.
• You have experience delivering full scope, CMS-based web projects for enterprise clients, ideally in an agency environment, and with a practical understanding of the WordPress platform..
• You love a challenge - whether that be a complex project or client - you are at your best when creating and delivering strategic solutions.
• You possess superior project awareness at all times; proactively tracking project budget and scope, identifying risks and mitigation paths, and delivering thoughtful, routine, comprehensive client updates.
• You demonstrate a senior-level consultative, client-focused approach that emanates expertise, professionalism, and transparency.
• You have excellent verbal and written English communication skills, both internally and externally. You are comfortable engaging and working with members of leadership to resolve conflicts and/or risks.

Benefits of interest:
• Multiple paid time off programs, including accrued PTO, parental leave, bereavement leave, and company holidays – including an all-company break from Christmas Eve to New Years Day.
• Health, dental, and life insurance programs (available for United States team members).
• Retirement contribution programs (currently available in the U.S. and U.K.).
• $3,000 USD accrued annually in professional development budget for you to spend on conferences, training, or to buy back time for programs like independent study.
• Flexible and alternate schedule programs - including options for 4-day work week (Monday-Thursday) configurations.
• Global Company summits – opportunities to meet, socialize and learn with fellow 10uppers in person at remarkable destinations.
• An end-of-year all-hands bonus program, along with smaller opportunities for recognition throughout the year.

What’s next?
• If you are passionate about 10up's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role even if you don't check all the boxes, please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to personally review your application. Everyone gets a response. Read more about What to Expect through our Recruiting process.
• We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@10up.com to your contacts list! #LI-Remote

We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@10up.com to your contacts list! #LI-Remote

jobs_results.title: Engineering Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
The Chemgineering Group is a global consulting and engineering company with branches in Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Spain, Mexico, Poland and Serbia. As specialists for efficient processes, we design and implement demanding projects for various industries in the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, fine chemicals, medical technology, cosmetics, vitamins, diagnostics and food.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a project engineer / junior project manager to join our engineering project management team in Spain.
• Management of projects throughout the project lifecycle, from design through to construction management and to start-up / commissioning of facilities
• Coordination with, and reporting to, the project sponsor
• Independent management and control of projects throughout their life cycle
• Direct client management
• Implementation of quality processes in projects and document management
• Management of multi-disciplinary technical project teams
• Development of technical... work (calculations, graphic design, diagrams, etc.), according to project needs and technical knowledge of the candidate

Your Profile
• Preferred qualifications: industrial or chemical engineer.
• 5 to 10 years of experience as engineering project manager
• Ability to understand and manage multi-disciplinary technical projects
• Knowledge of GMPs and experience in pharmaceutical environments
• Experience in related sectors will be an advantage: Healthcare, Fine Chemicals, Cosmetics, Food

Knowledge:
• Language: native or superior level in Spanish, medium/high level of English (fluent communication, both spoken and written). Knowledge of German is a plus
• Proficiency in Windows Office package
• Experienced user of MS Project for project planning

Other:
• Great opportunity for professional development in a varied and highly stimulating environment
• The selected candidate must be located in Barcelona or in Madrid
• Availability to travel (short trips, 2 days a week approx.). Having your own vehicle will be an advantage
• Ability to integrate into engineering project teams, working autonomously and in a structured manner
• Great opportunity to expand technical knowledge and skills
• Salary proposal according to the level of experience
• Immediate incorporation to the team

Your advantages at Chemgineering

Great opportunity for professional development in a varied and highly stimulating environment

Great opportunity to expand technical knowledge and skills

Salary proposal according to the level of experience

Become part of a high-prestige international engineering group

Focus your career on the Life Sciences sector

Apply now!

With our international teams, we carry out demanding consulting and planning projects and develop innovative solutions for well-known customers from the life sciences. Whether for innovative cancer therapies or in the complex regulations of the chemical, pharmaceutical and biotechnological industry - in this environment we offer you many career opportunities and excellent conditions for long-term development.

A family-friendly company with short lines of communication, a lot of creative freedom and a family corporate culture are waiting for you!

Apply now!

Kontakt

Virginia Juhel-Visalon

Human Resources Specialist

Tel: +49 (0) 611 778 8776

career@chemgineering.com

www.chemgineering.com

Teilen Sie diesen Job

jobs_results.title: Project Manager / COS support - FTC
jobs_results.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest... technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description

Incumbent will manage the pan-European executive reporting process which requires close collaboration with business line performance managers to ensure Key Performance Indicators and other management information updates are on track and supported with in-depth understanding of drivers behind the performance, support governance of regular EU Leadership forums, managing agenda and quality control of presentation content and preparation for various senior executive and Board meetings. In addition, given the dynamic nature of the Chief of Staff’s scope of work, new tasks/projects may be assigned. The incumbent will report to the Chief of Staff.

Basic Qualifications

- Structured, logical approach to problem solving

- Comfortable working with senior stakeholders

- Minimum 7 years work experience

Preferred Skills/Experience

- Commercial and Data analysis

- Leadership skills

Additional Job Description

Meeting Facilitation:
• European Executive Team meetings weekly and quarterly
• Manage agenda/recurring and new topics and issues
• Speakers invites
• Documentation management, incl timely uploads/readiness Reporting:
• Manage pan-European executive reporting process
• Manage reporting cycles for Elavon/US Bank Merchant Payment Services to support all pan European needs
• Collaborate with performance managers within each function (Revenue Segments, Commercial, Credit, Fraud, Operations, Finance) to ensure clarity and consistency in content
• Liaise with governance managers of executive forums
• Review and edit submissions for weekly/monthly reports for Senior Executive Team consumption
• Create reporting plan for H2-2024
• Monthly check-ins with Business Intelligence to ensure goals tracking and other management dashboard updates are on track

Other
• Revenue Segments/Commercial Line of Business monthly call attendance to ensure reporting is in line with the needs and expectations for the executive team reporting.
• European Executive Team Site maintenance
• Support goals and key performance indicator tracking for 2024
• Employee Engagement support as needed

#LI-AI1

#LI-Hybrid

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

We offer an exciting, fast-paced and diverse working environment with employees of many different nationalities. We provide benefits to help you protect your health and financial security; and give you peace of mind. We also invest in your career growth with development resources that give you the opportunity to stretch and shine

jobs_results.title: Services Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager Job Description

The Project Manager will drive projects from kick-off to successful completion, working with Kapturall teams and clients during the entire lifecycle of a project. In this role, the successful candidate will manage the deliverables, scope, budget, timeline, and client expectations for each project, as well as build a strong client relationship and expand business in existing accounts. As Project Manager, this person will also provide on-going status of their projects to the Delivery Management Team and is responsible for project profitability, account renewals, and client satisfaction (NPS).

Kapturall is still in “startup mode”, meaning you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty creating Gantt charts while simultaneously clearly articulating the “big picture” of why clients engage with us.

Responsibilities
• Responsible for ensuring that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and budget
• Ensure that stakeholder expectations are aligned... within the agreed scope of work
• Collaborate with the assigned project team to deliver projects on time and on budget
• Lead the post-sale onboarding and account management (along with the Marketing Consultant) and project setup
• Make proactive recommendations for new tools, processes, or skill sets that should be added to Kapturall to aid in project and account management
• Prioritize client needs based on available resources
• Plan and implement project schedules and timelines
• Organize project teams, allocate resources, manage budgets
• Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting for client stakeholders on overall project progress and success
• Implement and manage change when necessary, to meet project outputs
• Work with consultants and sales teams to ensure contract renewal in a timely fashion
• Grow the engagement with the client and identify upsell opportunities where appropriate and proactively manage a book of business

Qualifications
• At least 4 years of successful marketing agency or IT consulting firm project management experience
• Experience with one or more project management philosophies (PMI or similar certification an asset)
• Have one year of experience in a marketing-related field (an asset)
• Must be fluent in English, both written and spoken (interviews will be held in English)
• Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate in simple language to a variety of audiences
• Adobe Marketo Engage Knowledge (an asset)

Perks and Benefits
• Work with the best! Be part of a multi-cultural and ambitious team that is full of energy and enjoys learning and applying cutting-edge technology
• Competitive salary based on responsibilities and experience + Bonus based on performance
• Continuous training on areas ranging from digital marketing to soft skills
• Individual coaching sessions
• Paid Marketo Engage Certification
• Free Gym pass to a network of more than 2000 gyms throughout Spain
• Regular after works and fun activities, such as escape rooms, wine testing, or simply hang out with your colleagues
• Language classes paid for by Kapturall
• Flexible schedule and possibility of home office

About Kapturall

Kapturall is a fast-growing and industry-leading marketing operations agency and a silver adobe partner offering a wide range of consulting services to help our clients fully leverage Marketo Engage, optimize their processes, and achieve their business objectives.

Our mission is to help Marketers be successful in combining marketing technologies and data to create meaningful relationships that generate revenue.

We believe a better workplace creates a better customer experience. We work hard, but also play hard and love to learn and have fun. We have a young, dynamic and collaborative team in which you will have the opportunity to grow!

We’re based in Madrid and work for mid-sized and enterprise companies from all over Europe and LATAM, in different industries such as Software and Technology, Higher Education, Financial Services, Manufacturing, etc.

Project Manager Job Description

The Project Manager will drive projects from kick-off to successful completion, working with Kapturall teams and clients during the entire lifecycle of a project. In this role, the successful candidate will manage the deliverables, scope, budget, timeline, and client expectations for each project, as well as build a strong client relationship and expand business in existing accounts. As Project Manager, this person will also provide on-going status of their projects to the Delivery Management Team and is responsible for project profitability, account renewals, and client satisfaction (NPS).

Kapturall is still in “startup mode”, meaning you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty creating Gantt charts while simultaneously clearly articulating the “big picture” of why clients engage with us.

Responsibilities
• Responsible for ensuring that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and budget
• Ensure that stakeholder expectations are aligned... within the agreed scope of work
• Collaborate with the assigned project team to deliver projects on time and on budget
• Lead the post-sale onboarding and account management (along with the Marketing Consultant) and project setup
• Make proactive recommendations for new tools, processes, or skill sets that should be added to Kapturall to aid in project and account management
• Prioritize client needs based on available resources
• Plan and implement project schedules and timelines
• Organize project teams, allocate resources, manage budgets
• Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting for client stakeholders on overall project progress and success
• Implement and manage change when necessary, to meet project outputs
• Work with consultants and sales teams to ensure contract renewal in a timely fashion
• Grow the engagement with the client and identify upsell opportunities where appropriate and proactively manage a book of business

Qualifications
• At least 4 years of successful marketing agency or IT consulting firm project management experience
• Experience with one or more project management philosophies (PMI or similar certification an asset)
• Have one year of experience in a marketing-related field (an asset)
• Must be fluent in English, both written and spoken (interviews will be held in English)
• Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate in simple language to a variety of audiences
• Adobe Marketo Engage Knowledge (an asset)

Perks and Benefits
• Work with the best! Be part of a multi-cultural and ambitious team that is full of energy and enjoys learning and applying cutting-edge technology
• Competitive salary based on responsibilities and experience + Bonus based on performance
• Continuous training on areas ranging from digital marketing to soft skills
• Individual coaching sessions
• Paid Marketo Engage Certification
• Free Gym pass to a network of more than 2000 gyms throughout Spain
• Regular after works and fun activities, such as escape rooms, wine testing, or simply hang out with your colleagues
• Language classes paid for by Kapturall
• Flexible schedule and possibility of home office
